item.title: The home computer war
item.description:
📝 Texas Instruments didn’t give up, and soon found ways to cut the cost of their computer. This new category of video-game-adjacent personal computers became known as “home computers,” because of the ease with which ordinary householders could afford them. Oddly enough, the creation of the Color Computer (affectionately known as CoCo) began with a 1978 federal grant, for a computer system to disseminate information to Kentucky tobacco farmers.
🔗 Read more: https://technicshistory.com/2026/03/06/the-home-computer-war/
